name: sample_arterial_blood_gas
remarks: Baseline arterial specimen for the routine CABG preoperative and operative gas reports. This sampler does not model an acid-base complication or replace disease-specific gas panels.
Sample pH within 7.35-7.45, then sample PCO2 conditionally within 35-45 mmHg while retaining the existing bicarbonate bounds of 22-27 mmol/L.
Use the Abbott i-STAT calculated bicarbonate relationship at 37 degrees C: HCO3 = 10^(pH + log10(PCO2) - 7.608). The coefficient below is 10^(pH - 7.608), so HCO3 = coefficient * PCO2.
Source: Abbott i-STAT CG4+ Cartridge Instructions for Use, page 3: https://www.globalpointofcare.abbott/content/dam/ardx/globalpointofcare/apoc/support/i-stat-1/cti-ifu/english-uk/ifu/765788-01B.pdf

The conditional PCO2 interval is [max(35, 22/coefficient), min(45, 27/coefficient)]; it is nonempty throughout the sampled pH interval. Draw one fraction within that interval rather than sampling mutually inconsistent analytes independently.

Each invocation refreshes all specimen attributes; report observations read the resulting snapshot without additional random draws. Oxygen partial pressure and saturation remain in the calling report.
